cursor.note: THIS END IS THE HOLDER. The shim's drain generalised from one lane to three (GATES = raise, clear, reconcile) with a PER-GATE watermark, because the marks are filename high-water marks and 'c' < 'r' — one shared mark silently skips a clear that shares a stamp with a raise. _fold dispatches by gate and RAISES on an unknown one rather than returning, because a drain that scanned a lane it cannot apply would drop the emission silently. The clear fold DECLINES a not-live identity instead of refusing it: a refusal HOLDS the watermark by design (a fault must not be skipped past), so a declined clear taking the refusal path would wedge the lane forever. Reconcile clears only identities under its scope prefix — another reporter's trouble in the same store is untouchable. Five teeth added, all three properties mutation-tested at 34/35 with only the intended tooth red. || THE FINDING THIS VOYAGE OWES A READER IN A YEAR: A BUS DIAL IS A DATABASE DIAL, STATICALLY. cairn/tools/base/bus_client.py reaches denied capability two ways — inference_seam() imports cairn.devices.inference_domain, and _wire() imports bus.bus which imports cairn.devices.db_domain — and build_inspector's own fire_path_unreachable sieve walks the STATIC import graph counting function-local imports as edges, so laziness cannot evade it. Therefore any in-process bus dial statically reaches a database and the inference host, and the build inspector, which must reach neither, CAN NEVER BE A BUS CLIENT. Commit 433cdc9 shipped the chart's 'reconcile clears via the verb' bound and the sieve red it; the bound was not awkward, it was impossible. THE REPLACEMENT IS THE SEAM THE RAISE ALREADY CROSSES: two more emission lanes beside raise_trouble — clear_trouble(identity, by, what_changed) and reconcile_troubles(scope, still, by, what_changed) — each with its own gate name and therefore its own watermark in the drain. Sending is a tool; holding is owned. 433cdc9's ownership reasoning was RIGHT and its conclusion did not follow: what must happen in the owner's hand is the DECIDING and the WRITING, not the ASKING. reconcile is the shape that made it work — a reconciler cannot know what is STALE without READING the store, and both read routes are shut, so it hands the holder the COMPLETE current picture under a scope and the holder clears the rest, moving both halves of the read-modify-write into the one process that owns the JSON. Verdict artifact verdict-20260908T172545-d3f15eb2dd5f.json: 4 of 4 criteria pass, 4 hypotheses confirmed and ONE KILLED — hypothesis 4's 'reconcile clears through the verb', killed by the static measurement above. MEASURED: inspector run reports 0 device_isolation_holds and 0 fire_path_unreachable; raise -> notifier poke -> drain -> bus live -> pane data -> rendered HTML at a 4.2ms median over 5 runs against the clause's 1s budget; test_trouble.py 35/35 and test_diagnostic.py 14/14, each run twice and each mutation-tested.
